## What's new in v0.2.3

- Linked split tabs with separate address bars and back, forward, refresh, and home controls for each page.
- Drag the divider to resize split panes; double-click it to restore equal widths.
- Swap linked pages using the chain icon, or turn Split off to separate them into independent tabs without reloading.
- Drag tabs to reorder them. Linked split tabs move together.
- Tabs fit their page titles and shrink as the bar fills, with smooth linking and separation animations.
- When maximized, tabs can be selected or dragged from the very top edge of the screen.
- Local AI offline pages retry every 10 seconds with a live countdown and reconnect when the server becomes available.
- Improved local-server connection handling and loading indicators.
- Simplified the AI Dock by removing the Gradio / WebUI and JoyCaption shortcuts and the port input arrows. Removed the VRAM Saver button.
- Added `start-dev.bat` and `start-desktop-dev.bat` launchers for development.

## Windows installers

Choose either the **EXE setup** or **MSI installer** from the assets below. Both install AuraView v0.2.3 for Windows x64.
